messages:
Ava: Quick poll: what's more embarrassing — misbuttoned shirt or loud phone ringtone in a meeting? :thinking_face: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/whoops-awkward-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc
Jon: Misbuttoned shirt. I wore mine inside-out to a sync last week. :grimacing: never living it down
Priya: Ringtone, for sure. mine once blasted 'baby shark' during exec Q&A. still haunted. 😂
Liam: Both are tragic. awarding a 'Most Relatable' title to whoever confesses first. :trophy:
Ava: Also: micro one-liner contest. Drop your best one-liner here. Loser buys a coffee on next bakery run ☕
sam-bot: Reminder: free pastries in kitchen until 11:30. :croissant:
Jon: "I told my plants about our quarterly goals. they're wilting from the pressure."
Priya: "I put my phone on 'Do Not Disturb' and now my anxiety is the one ringing."
Liam: "My to-do list and I are in a complicated relationship: we keep breaking up, but then I just add more tasks."
Ava: "I told my calendar I needed space. it scheduled a therapy appointment for my inbox."
Jon: ok that's a tie between Priya and Ava. :raised_hands:
Priya: also quick kudos to @Liam — thanks for rescuing the espresso machine yesterday. champion. :coffee: :sparkles:
Liam: haha thanks, team. small victory. :smile:
Ava: Vote with emoji for the one-liner you want immortalized on the 'Office Wit' sticky note wall. :memo:
Jon: :thumbsup: for Priya
Priya: :laughing: for Ava
sam-bot: Reaction summary: Priya (1), Ava (1), Jon (1)
Ava: Alright, contest over. Baker run tomorrow: Priya picks pastry, Jon pays (loser). :money_with_wings:
Liam: I'll bring celebratory stickers. :star:
metadata_note: single-thread Slack conversation, short informal messages with emojis, @mentions, and a bot line. No title field per agents.md rules.
